draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.88, the 206th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 19th of 24 at DT. He lasted until pick 234, well after his grade rank (206th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1 sacks in 2023, 20th of 24 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Las Vegas Raiders. 34 career games and 22 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Still developing: 6 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 67.9% (91st percentile), tackles for loss 8 (91st percentile), sacks 4.0 (84th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 16.4% (4th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 interior lineman who played: 11 pressures against a median of 3, above the norm.
